study.title: AgriFusion: Multiscale RGB-NIR Fusion for Semantic Segmentation in Airborne Agricultural Imagery
study.short_title: AgriFusion dual-encoder RGB-NIR fusion; mIoU 0.4931, PA 0.8172, F1 0.6785

segmentation.domain: multimodal RGB-NIR semantic segmentation of agricultural field anomalies (planting anomalies and crop stresses: double plant, dry down, end row, nutrient deficiency, planter skip, water, waterway, weed cluster) on the Agriculture-Vision benchmark
models_tested: AgriFusion (asymmetric dual-encoder: MiT-B1 on RGB + ResNet-18 on NIR, AFF attention fusion, MLP decoder)
segmentation.best_model: AgriFusion with MiT-B1 + ResNet-18 encoders: mIoU 49.31%, PA 81.72%, F1 67.85% (mean over 5 runs, p<0.001 vs all baselines)

dataset.name: Agriculture-Vision (94,986 RGB+NIR aerial images from 3432 fields across the United States; GSD up to 10 cm/px; 8 adopted anomaly classes + background after excluding storm damage due to annotation inconsistency)
dataset.note: Airborne (not UAV) benchmark imagery; RGB + single-channel NIR. Official split: 70% train / 15% val / 15% test. Authors note AgriFusion is 'inherently suitable for UAV-based agricultural monitoring' but no UAV/edge deployment was performed.

segmentation.backbone: MiT-B1 transformer (RGB branch) + ResNet-18 CNN (NIR branch), multi-scale AFF fusion, MLP decoder (SegFormer-style)

mIoU.quote: AgriFusion achieves an mIoU of 49.31%, PA of 81.72%, and F1 score of 67.85%
mIoU.ambiguity: Mean mIoU over 5 runs (49.31 +/- 0.28). 8 anomaly classes + background.

mPA.ambiguity: Authors report global Pixel Accuracy (PA = TP+TN/all), not class-mean accuracy.

F1.quote: AgriFusion achieves an mIoU of 49.31%, PA of 81.72%, and F1 score of 67.85%

Dice.ambiguity: Dice coefficient not reported as a metric (Dice loss used only during training; F1 score reported instead).

PA.quote: AgriFusion achieves an mIoU of 49.31%, PA of 81.72%, and F1 score of 67.85%
PA.ambiguity: Pixel Accuracy as defined in Eq. (11): (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN), i.e. global pixel accuracy.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed cluster (WC) is one of 8 anomaly classes; per-class WF1 not reported. Per-class IoU for WC = 31.41%.

crop_F1.ambiguity: No per-crop-class F1; task is anomaly segmentation, not crop/weed binary.

edge.framework: PyTorch; trained on NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPU (22 GB) for 100 epochs, batch size 64, Adam lr 0.001, CE + Dice loss; MiT-B1 and ResNet-18 pretrained-initialized

params_M.ambiguity: Parameter counts not reported (MiT-B1/ResNet-18 architecture noted as relatively efficient but not quantified).

issues: Evaluation on the airborne Agriculture-Vision benchmark, NOT UAV-collected imagery; UAV deployment only discussed as future work.
Storm damage class excluded (8 anomaly classes + background adopted) due to annotation inconsistency.
No inference speed, latency, parameter, or power figures; GPU-only training on RTX 2080Ti.
Reported F1 uses the balanced per-class definition (Eq. 12), not the mean-IoU-style aggregation.
